        - ((Tset L m a).card : ℝ) * (rootCount d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)| ≤ (rootCount d : ℝ)

name: FactorialHypergraph.card_Tset_le
statement:
theorem card_Tset_le (L m a : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ((Tset L m a).card : ℝ) ≤ (L : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) + 1

name: FactorialHypergraph.card_block
statement:
theorem card_block (d r : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hr : r < d) (q : ℕ) : ∀ u s : ℕ,
    ((Finset.Ico u (u + (d * q + s))).filter (fun t => t % d = r)).card
      = q + ((Finset.Ico (u + d * q) (u + d * q + s)).filter (fun t => t % d = r)).card

name: FactorialHypergraph.card_roots_Gpoly
statement:
theorem card_roots_Gpoly {m a d : ℕ} (_hm : 0 < m) (hdvd : m ∣ fq a) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime d m) :
    ((Finset.range d).filter (fun r => d ∣ Gpoly m a r)).card = rootCount d

name: FactorialHypergraph.card_window
statement:
theorem card_window (u d r : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hr : r < d) :
    ((Finset.Ico u (u + d)).filter (fun t => t % d = r)).card = 1

name: FactorialHypergraph.card_window_le
statement:
theorem card_window_le (u s d r : ℕ) (hs : s ≤ d) :
    ((Finset.Ico u (u + s)).filter (fun t => t % d = r)).card ≤ 1

name: FactorialHypergraph.dvd_fq_add_mul
statement: theorem dvd_fq_add_mul {m a : ℕ} (hdvd : m ∣ fq a) (t : ℕ) : m ∣ fq (a + m * t)

name: FactorialHypergraph.le_card_Tset
statement:
theorem le_card_Tset (L m a : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (ham : a < m) :

name: FactorialHypergraph.mem_Tset
statement:
theorem mem_Tset {L m a t : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :

name: FactorialHypergraph.nat_div_bounds
statement:
theorem nat_div_bounds (x m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ((x / m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ∧ (x : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) < ((x / m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1

name: FactorialHypergraph.gLoc_div_le
statement:
theorem gLoc_div_le {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hchi : p % 5 = 1 ∨ p % 5 = 4) :
    gLoc p / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ≤ 2 / (p : ℝ) + 9 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2

name: FactorialHypergraph.local_sum_gMaj_le
statement:
theorem local_sum_gMaj_le {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (E : ℕ) :
    ∑ e ∈ Finset.range (E + 1), gMaj (p ^ e) / (p ^ e : ℝ) ≤ 1 + gLoc p / ((p : ℝ) - 1)

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_Icc_le_prod_primesBelow
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_le_prod_primesBelow (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hf1 : f 1 = 1)
    (hmul : ∀ m n : ℕ, Nat.Coprime m n → f (m * n) = f m * f n) (N E : ℕ)
    (hE : N < 2 ^ (E + 1)) :
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f m
      ≤ ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesBelow (N + 1), ∑ e ∈ Finset.range (E + 1), f (p ^ e)

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_gLoc_div_le
statement:
theorem sum_gLoc_div_le (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesBelow (N + 1), gLoc p / ((p : ℝ) - 1)
      ≤ 2 * (∑ p ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N with (Nat.Prime p ∧ chi5 p = 1), (1 : ℝ) / p) + 10

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_gMaj_div_le
statement:
theorem sum_gMaj_div_le :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, gMaj m / (m : ℝ) ≤ C * (1 + Real.log N)

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_inv_le_one_add_log
statement:
theorem sum_inv_le_one_add_log (N : ℕ) :

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_inv_sq_Icc_le
statement: theorem sum_inv_sq_Icc_le (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_inv_sq_primes_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sq_primes_le (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesBelow (N + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_inv_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sqrt_le (B : ℕ) :
    ∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 B, 1 / Real.sqrt b ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt B

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_rootCount_div_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem sum_rootCount_div_sqrt_le (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (rootCount m : ℝ) / Real.sqrt m
      ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt N * (1 + Real.log N)

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_smooth_le_prod
statement:
theorem sum_smooth_le_prod (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hf1 : f 1 = 1)
    (hmul : ∀ m n : ℕ, Nat.Coprime m n → f (m * n) = f m * f n) (N E : ℕ)
    (hE : N < 2 ^ (E + 1)) :
    ∀ P : Finset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) →
      ∑ m ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun m => ∀ q ∈ m.primeFactors, q ∈ P), f m
        ≤ ∏ p ∈ P, ∑ e ∈ Finset.range (E + 1), f (p ^ e)

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_log_ge
statement:
theorem sum_log_ge (N : ℕ) :
    (N : ℝ) * Real.log N - N ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Real.log n

name: FactorialHypergraph.dimension_condition
statement:
theorem dimension_condition :
    ∃ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ∀ P : Finset ℕ, (∀ ℓ ∈ P, Nat.Prime ℓ) → ∀ w : ℝ, 2 ≤ w →
      ∑ ℓ ∈ P with (((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ w), (rootCount ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log ℓ / (ℓ : ℝ)
        ≤ Real.log w + C₁

name: FactorialHypergraph.dimension_condition_interval
statement:
theorem dimension_condition_interval :
    ∃ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ∀ P : Finset ℕ, (∀ ℓ ∈ P, Nat.Prime ℓ) → ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ, 2 ≤ w₁ → w₁ ≤ w₂ →
      ∑ ℓ ∈ P with (w₁ < ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧ ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ w₂),
          (rootCount ℓ : ℝ) * Real.log ℓ / (ℓ : ℝ)
        ≤ Real.log (w₂ / w₁) + C₁

name: FactorialHypergraph.mem_sievePrimes
statement:
theorem mem_sievePrimes {m ℓ : ℕ} {z : ℝ} :

name: FactorialHypergraph.ne_two_five_of_mem_sievePrimes

name: FactorialHypergraph.sieveProduct_eq_chi

name: FactorialHypergraph.sieveProduct_factor_mem

name: FactorialHypergraph.sieveProduct_le
statement:

name: FactorialHypergraph.sieveProduct_le_mul_hFactor

name: FactorialHypergraph.sieveProduct_pos

name: FactorialHypergraph.card_filter_comp_eq_sum

theorem card_filter_comp_eq_sum (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (Q : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred Q] :

name: FactorialHypergraph.card_prime_values_le
statement:
theorem card_prime_values_le (hs : UpperBoundSieveDimOne) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ L : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → (m : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt L →
      ∀ a : ℕ, a < m → m ∣ fq a →
        (((Tset L m a).filter (fun t => Nat.Prime (Gpoly m a t) ∧ L < Gpoly m a t)).card : ℝ)
          ≤ C * ((L : ℝ) * hFactor m / ((m : ℝ) * Real.log L)
                + Real.sqrt ((L : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) * Real.log L)

name: FactorialHypergraph.div_log_le_aux
statement:
theorem div_log_le_aux {L m HR : ℝ} (hL0 : 0 < L) (hmR0 : 0 < m)
    (hHR2 : HR ≤ 2 * L / m) (hlogL100 : (100:ℝ) ≤ Real.log L)

name: FactorialHypergraph.rootCount_prod_primes
statement:

name: FactorialHypergraph.sieve_bound_single
statement:
theorem sieve_bound_single (hs : UpperBoundSieveDimOne) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (L m a : ℕ) (z D : ℝ), 0 < m → a < m → m ∣ fq a →
      2 ≤ z → z ≤ (L : ℝ) → z ^ (10 : ℕ) ≤ D →
      (((Tset L m a).filter (fun t => Nat.Prime (Gpoly m a t) ∧ L < Gpoly m a t)).card : ℝ)
        ≤ C * (((Tset L m a).card : ℝ) * sieveProduct m z
            + ∑ d ∈ sieveDivisors (sievePrimes m z) with (((d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ D),
                (rootCount d : ℝ))

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_card_divisors_le
statement:
theorem sum_card_divisors_le (M : ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, ((d.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log M)

name: FactorialHypergraph.sum_rootCount_sieveDivisors_le

theorem sum_rootCount_sieveDivisors_le (m : ℕ) (z D : ℝ) (hD : 1 ≤ D) :

name: FactorialHypergraph.card_smallCofactorSet_le_sum
statement:
theorem card_smallCofactorSet_le_sum (α : ℝ) (L Y : ℕ)
    (hY : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → (m : ℝ) ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ α → m ≤ Y) :
    (smallCofactorSet α L).card
      ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Y, ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range m).filter (fun a => m ∣ fq a),
          ((Tset L m a).filter
            (fun t => Nat.Prime (Gpoly m a t) ∧ L < Gpoly m a t)).card

name: FactorialHypergraph.smallCofactorSieve_of_inputs
statement:
theorem smallCofactorSieve_of_inputs (hs : UpperBoundSieveDimOne) :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α ≤ 1 / 2 →
      ∀ L : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L →
        ((smallCofactorSet α L).card : ℝ)
          ≤ C₀ * (α * L + (L : ℝ) / Real.log L + (L : ℝ) ^ ((1 + α) / 2) * (Real.log L) ^ 2)

name: FactorialHypergraph.dim_anchored_of_interval
statement:
theorem dim_anchored_of_interval {P : Finset ℕ} {rho : ℕ → ℝ} {C₁ : ℝ}
    (hP : ∀ ℓ ∈ P, Nat.Prime ℓ) (hloc : ∀ ℓ ∈ P, rho ℓ / (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (hI : ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ, 2 ≤ w₁ → w₁ ≤ w₂ →
      ∑ ℓ ∈ P with (w₁ < ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧ ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ w₂),
          rho ℓ * Real.log ℓ / (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (w₂ / w₁) + C₁) :
    ∀ w : ℝ, 2 ≤ w →
      ∑ ℓ ∈ P with (((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ w), rho ℓ * Real.log ℓ / (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ Real.log w + C₁

name: FactorialHypergraph.interval_condition_of_bounded_range
statement:
theorem interval_condition_of_bounded_range {P : Finset ℕ} {rho : ℕ → ℝ} {C₁ y : ℝ}
    (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (hPy : ∀ ℓ ∈ P, ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ y)
    (h : ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ, 2 ≤ w₁ → w₁ ≤ w₂ → w₂ ≤ y →
      ∑ ℓ ∈ P with (w₁ < ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧ ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ w₂),
          rho ℓ * Real.log ℓ / (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (w₂ / w₁) + C₁) :
    ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ, 2 ≤ w₁ → w₁ ≤ w₂ →
      ∑ ℓ ∈ P with (w₁ < ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧ ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ w₂),

name: FactorialHypergraph.mem_sieveDivisors_iff

name: FactorialHypergraph.remainder_sum_mono
statement:

name: FactorialHypergraph.remainder_sum_nonneg
statement:
theorem remainder_sum_nonneg (P : Finset ℕ) (A : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (rho : ℕ → ℝ) (X D : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ d ∈ sieveDivisors P with (((d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ D),
        |(∑ n ∈ A with (d ∣ n), a n) - X * rho d / (d : ℝ)|

name: FactorialHypergraph.sieve_conclusion_of_empty
statement:
theorem sieve_conclusion_of_empty (A : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (rho : ℕ → ℝ) (X D C : ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hX : X = ∑ n ∈ A, a n) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∑ n ∈ A with (∀ ℓ ∈ (∅ : Finset ℕ), ¬ (ℓ ∣ n)), a n
      ≤ C * (X * ∏ ℓ ∈ (∅ : Finset ℕ), (1 - rho ℓ / (ℓ : ℝ))
          + ∑ d ∈ sieveDivisors (∅ : Finset ℕ) with (((d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ D),
              |(∑ n ∈ A with (d ∣ n), a n) - X * rho d / (d : ℝ)|)

name: FactorialHypergraph.sifted_sum_eq_coprime_sum

name: FactorialHypergraph.collision_criterion
statement:
theorem collision_criterion {L i j q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hqL : L < q)
    (hij : i ≤ j) (hjL : j ≤ L) :
    (i.factorial ≡ j.factorial [MOD q] ↔ (∏ r ∈ Finset.Ioc i j, r) ≡ 1 [MOD q]) ∧
    ((∏ r ∈ Finset.Ioc i j, r) ≡ 1 [MOD q] ↔
      (q : ℤ) ∣ ((∏ r ∈ Finset.Ioc i j, r : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)

name: FactorialHypergraph.factorial_add_two_sub_factorial
statement:
theorem factorial_add_two_sub_factorial (i : ℕ) :
    (i + 2).factorial - i.factorial = i.factorial * fq i

name: FactorialHypergraph.factorial_add_two_sub_factorial_int
statement:
theorem factorial_add_two_sub_factorial_int (i : ℕ) :
    ((i + 2).factorial : ℤ) - (i.factorial : ℤ) = (i.factorial : ℤ) * (i ^ 2 + 3 * i + 1)

name: FactorialHypergraph.factorial_modEq_of_dvd_fq
statement:
theorem factorial_modEq_of_dvd_fq {i q : ℕ} (h : q ∣ fq i) :
    i.factorial ≡ (i + 2).factorial [MOD q]

name: FactorialHypergraph.factorial_mul_prod_Ioc
statement:
lemma factorial_mul_prod_Ioc {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) :
    i.factorial * ∏ r ∈ Finset.Ioc i j, r = j.factorial

name: FactorialHypergraph.pair_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem pair_mem_fiber {L i q : ℕ} (h : q ∣ fq i) (hi : 2 ≤ i) (hiL : i + 2 ≤ L) :
    i ∈ fiber L q i.factorial ∧ (i + 2) ∈ fiber L q i.factorial

name: FactorialHypergraph.exists_indepSet_card
statement:
theorem exists_indepSet_card (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (D : ℕ)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ D) :
    ∃ s : Finset α, (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, ¬ G.Adj x y) ∧
      (Fintype.card α : ℝ) ≤ (D + 1) * s.card

name: FactorialHypergraph.exists_indepSet_weight
statement:
theorem exists_indepSet_weight (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (D : ℕ)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ D) (w : α → ℝ) :
    ∃ s : Finset α, (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, ¬ G.Adj x y) ∧
      ∑ v : α, w v ≤ (D + 1) * ∑ v ∈ s, w v

name: FactorialHypergraph.exists_proper_coloring
statement:
theorem exists_proper_coloring (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (D : ℕ)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ D) :
    ∃ c : α → Fin (D + 1), ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → c x ≠ c y

name: FactorialHypergraph.indepSet_conflictGraph
statement:
theorem indepSet_conflictGraph {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (col : ι → ℕ) (B : ι → Finset ℕ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, ¬ (conflictGraph col B).Adj x y) :
    (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → col x ≠ col y) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x ≠ y → Disjoint (B x) (B y))

name: FactorialHypergraph.card_goodSet_ge
statement:
theorem card_goodSet_ge (hL : 3 ≤ L) (C : RainbowCover L) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : 2 * L.factorial + 2 * (C.modulus * primorial L)
        + m * (C.modulus * primorial L) ≤ (L + 1).factorial) :
    m ≤ (goodSet L).card

name: FactorialHypergraph.coprime_modulus_primorial
statement:
theorem coprime_modulus_primorial (C : RainbowCover L) :
    Nat.Coprime C.modulus (primorial L)

name: FactorialHypergraph.exists_base
statement:
theorem exists_base {c P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ base : ℕ, c < base ∧ base ≤ c + 2 * P ∧ base % P = r % P

name: FactorialHypergraph.exists_progression
statement:
theorem exists_progression (hL : 3 ≤ L) (C : RainbowCover L) :
    ∃ base : ℕ, 2 * L.factorial < base ∧
      base ≤ 2 * L.factorial + 2 * (C.modulus * primorial L) ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, base + j * (C.modulus * primorial L) ≤ (L + 1).factorial →
        base + j * (C.modulus * primorial L) ∈ goodSet L

name: FactorialHypergraph.not_prime_of_proper_divisor
statement:
theorem not_prime_of_proper_divisor {N d : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ N) (h1 : 1 < d) (h2 : d < N) :
    ¬ N.Prime

name: FactorialHypergraph.transference
statement:
theorem transference (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1) :
    ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ L, L₀ ≤ L → ∀ C : RainbowCover L,
      (C.modulus : ℝ) ≤ ((L + 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ (1 - η) →
      ((L + 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ (η / 2) / (100 * Real.log L) ≤ ((goodSet L).card : ℝ)

name: FactorialHypergraph.auxiliary_erdos_problem
statement:
theorem auxiliary_erdos_problem (h : AnalyticInputs) :
    ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ L : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → ∃ n : ℕ,
      L.factorial < n ∧
      n ≤ (L + 1).factorial ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ n → L < p) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ L → ¬ (n - k.factorial).Prime ∧ 1 < n - k.factorial

name: FactorialHypergraph.baseline_cover_cost
statement:
theorem baseline_cover_cost :
    ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ L : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L →
      kappa L ≤ ((L : ℝ) - 1) * Real.log (21 * (L : ℝ) * Real.log L)

name: FactorialHypergraph.card_complement_pairs
statement:
theorem card_complement_pairs {L : ℕ} (I : Finset ℕ)
    (hI : ∀ i ∈ I, 2 ≤ i ∧ i + 2 ≤ L)
    (hdisj : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ I, i ≠ j → i + 2 ≠ j ∧ j + 2 ≠ i) :
    ((V L) \ (I.biUnion (fun i => ({i, i + 2} : Finset ℕ)))).card + 2 * I.card = L - 1

name: FactorialHypergraph.cover_cost
statement:
theorem cover_cost (h : AnalyticInputs) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ L : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → kappa L ≤ (1 - δ) * L * Real.log L

name: FactorialHypergraph.exists_cover_from_data
statement:
theorem exists_cover_from_data {L : ℕ} (I : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ → ℕ) (U : Finset ℕ) (r : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hI : ∀ i ∈ I, 2 ≤ i ∧ i + 2 ≤ L ∧ (q i).Prime ∧ q i ∣ fq i ∧ L < q i ∧ q i < L.factorial)
    (hqinj : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ I, i ≠ j → q i ≠ q j)
    (hU : U = (V L) \ (I.biUnion (fun i => ({i, i + 2} : Finset ℕ))))
    (hr : ∀ k ∈ U, (r k).Prime ∧ L < r k ∧ r k < L.factorial)
    (hrinj : ∀ k ∈ U, ∀ l ∈ U, k ≠ l → r k ≠ r l)
    (hqr : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ k ∈ U, q i ≠ r k) :
    ∃ C : RainbowCover L,
      C.weight = (∑ i ∈ I, Real.log (q i)) + (∑ k ∈ U, Real.log (r k))

name: FactorialHypergraph.exists_disjoint_pairs
statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_pairs {L : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, 2 ≤ i ∧ i + 2 ≤ L ∧ (q i).Prime ∧ q i ∣ fq i ∧ L < q i) (_hL : 5 < L) :
    ∃ I ⊆ S, (S.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (I.card : ℝ) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ I, i ≠ j → q i ≠ q j) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ I, i ≠ j → i + 2 ≠ j ∧ j + 2 ≠ i)

name: FactorialHypergraph.exists_good_indices
statement:
theorem exists_good_indices (h : AnalyticInputs) {α₀ : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α₀) (hα1 : α₀ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hsieve : ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ L : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → ((smallCofactorSet α₀ L).card : ℝ) ≤ (L : ℝ) / 500) :
    ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ L : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → ∃ (S : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ → ℕ),
      9 * (L : ℝ) / 100 ≤ (S.card : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ i ∈ S, 2 ≤ i ∧ i + 2 ≤ L ∧ (q i).Prime ∧ q i ∣ fq i ∧ L < q i ∧
        (q i : ℝ) < 2 * (L : ℝ) ^ (2 - α₀)

name: FactorialHypergraph.exists_lowweight_cover
statement:
theorem exists_lowweight_cover (h : AnalyticInputs) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ L : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L →
      ∃ C : RainbowCover L, C.weight ≤ (1 - δ) * L * Real.log L

name: FactorialHypergraph.exists_prime_assignment
statement:
theorem exists_prime_assignment {L : ℕ} (U T : Finset ℕ)
    (hsupply : 2 * L ≤ (primesIn L ⌈20 * (L : ℝ) * Real.log L⌉₊).card)
    (hT : T.card ≤ L) (hU : U.card ≤ L) :
    ∃ r : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ k ∈ U, ∀ l ∈ U, k ≠ l → r k ≠ r l) ∧
      ∀ k ∈ U, r k ∈ primesIn L ⌈20 * (L : ℝ) * Real.log L⌉₊ ∧ r k ∉ T

name: FactorialHypergraph.main_quantitative

name: FactorialHypergraph.modulus_le_of_weight
